title: extensions.backlog_commands is the one extension point whose it_ops_kb entry point is never read
goal: with no extensions.backlog_commands setting, bl_cli.load_group_commands loads the modules an it_ops_kb.backlog_commands entry point names, as the other points do, and costs no import of kbext when no entry point of that group is installed

run:
import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
T=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
def W(p,v):
    p=pathlib.Path(p); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_text(v if isinstance(v,str) else json.dumps(v),encoding="utf-8"); return p
def need(c,m):
    if not c: sys.exit("not yet: "+str(m)[:800])
def R(*a,env=None):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,**(env or {})),timeout=600)
EXT='KBEXT_REQUIRES = ">=0.1"\n'
e=T/"ext"; W(e/"gcmds.py",EXT+"import bl_cli\nbl_cli.register('hello', lambda a: print('hi'))\n")
d=T/"site"/"gx-0.1.dist-info"; W(d/"METADATA","Metadata-Version: 2.1\nName: gx\nVersion: 0.1\n")
W(d/"entry_points.txt","[it_ops_kb.backlog_commands]\ngx = gcmds\n")
sys.path[:0]=[str(T/"site"),str(e)]
W(T/"ws"/"settings.json",{})
import bl_cli
bl_cli.load_group_commands(T/"ws")
need("hello" in bl_cli.COMMANDS, "an entry point of group it_ops_kb.backlog_commands loaded no command")
